parole.significato: skirt, skirts (of a jacket, morning coat etc.); basque (of waistcoat)
parole.testo: Inherited from Old French baste, probably borrowed from Provençal or Occitan basto, from Frankish *bastijan (“to weave, plait, sew”). But others suggest it was named after the fashion of the Basques, the same as basquine and Spanish basquiña.
